replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body: It is a code that contains all of the information for a map in a certain gamemode. For example, if you were making a Red Alert map, you would need a .yml file to code the falling blocks. Another example would be for Nebula. The file (or code) would include information such as the coordinates of the spawnpoints, and similar information.

replies.author: Netuxx
replies.body:
The .yml file, more known as YAML or YML file is a file that contains certain information.
We use YML files in Avicus Maps to set information about where the spawn is located, zones where you can't enter, etc.
More information about how to do this stuff is here (click on here).

Hope it helped ^_^. I think i did it quite too much formal xD
~Netux
